additional_info.subject: RE: ID0381502-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R5 170001937] Charger was flickering green and red CRM:00642001553
additional_info.body:
Dear Lorenz,
I hope all is well with you. I'm Sambath, and I'll be supporting you on this case from expert team. Please be informed that I have acquired the necessary logs and examined the unusual behaviors on the EcoG end. The logs make it evident that the problem lasted for about fifteen minutes before a remote reboot. The charger functions flawlessly following the reboot. This abnormality happened not just on September 26 but again on October 29. For your reference, kindly refer to the screenshot that is provided.
The logs make it quite evident that this anomaly is not the result of any other charger error. When I examined the charger today, outlet 1 had phase undefined (Pilot state) and was out of order. After an EcoG power cycle, the outlet came online. Additionally, it's pointing to an EcoG internal fault. I prefer to observe the outlet for a couple of days, and in case the error reappear, let us plan to replace the EcoG LE.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
